name: @vzn/vx-history-server
description: The task timings a vx scheduler asks for, one folded row per task, that you host: on Bun with SQLite, on Cloudflare Workers with D1, or as a Docker image.
//: @vzn/vx: vx.config.ts's core; `*`, not workspace:, which npm refuses when a deploy installs this directory alone.
@vzn/vx-devtools: checks the CI tokens, the check vx's servers share (it imports only jose); `*` for the same reason.
jose: the tests sign the CI tokens the server checks.
miniflare: tests/worker.test.ts runs src/worker.ts in workerd with D1, as Workers deploy it.
